_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Moos on a {width}×{height} grid.
Ad waxaad u direysaa mooska {player_id}. Guulaysiyada saxda ah: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (ama w/s/a/d).
Haddaftirka: nolosha ugu dheer ama ugu dheer iyo ugu sarreeya oo ugu sarreeya (xaddig dhiman {max_turns} xaddig).

game_action.invalid_death: Moos {player_id} wuu ku dhintay sababtoo ah guulaysi aan caadi ahayn.

outcome.survived_win: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} wuu badbaaday; dhammaan kuwa kale way dhinteen.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Masaska oo dhan waxay u dhinteen si isku mar ah.
outcome.turn_limit: Xadka wareega ayaa la gaaray - dhibcaha ugu fiican ayaa ku guuleysta isku dheelitirka.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Kooxaha darajooyinka ugu dambeeya (ugu xun→ugu fiican): {groups}
